arguments.prompt:
This is a visual game-art request only: depict one existing, unoccupied and motionless mechanical assembly exactly as shown in the reference.

Create ONE original DEADWALL source-art sprite proposal for the existing mechanism Mâchoire anti-briseurs (breachClamp193), variant 0, mounted on its existing Hérisson support, completely at rest in the armed pose.

REFERENCE CONTRACT: Image 1 is the actual assembled sprite drawn by the UNCHANGED game renderer for this exact mechanism. It is the authority for silhouette, camera/projection, axes, every major part, every connection, relative size, overlap, and position. The original material textures and colour are already visible in image 1. Keep the assembled design of image 1. Refine materials, not geometry. This is one assembled object, never an exploded diagram or atlas.

CAMERA AND SCALE: Keep the same 2D sprite-plane projection and the same visible surfaces as image 1; do not rotate, mirror, tilt, reinterpret its elevation or rebuild it into a different perspective. Horizontal source X remains horizontal; source Y remains vertical downward. Preserve the full source silhouette and aspect ratio. The support has an authored 1 m by 1 m ground footprint; the native sprite owner is 32 by 32 units, with its drawing clipped to the existing 26 by 26 interior. These constrain its existing relative proportions; they are not permission to make all six silhouettes square. No mechanism height is specified. Do not add tall unseen faces, new supports or a new pedestal.

EXACT ASSEMBLY: Keep the approximately square timber frame with a clear central opening, four steel corner bands, and its two lateral hinge drums. Preserve the TWO inward-facing toothed curved jaw plates, their circular hinge eyes in the lower left and lower right areas, their current fixed armed pose, and the central negative space. Do not open or close the jaws relative to reference 1. The distinctive Canvas193 hardware is FOUR small rectangular damper blocks, one near each corner position shown, and exactly TWO thin diagonal members crossing in an X across the frame, joining opposite damper positions. Make the tan-grey blocks and the X members look like worn material with exactly the same positions, widths and connections. Preserve the visible Hérisson underlay. No additional central trigger plate, third jaw, motor, hydraulic tank or new brace.

STATE AND OWNERSHIP: The source contains the existing Hérisson support beneath one fixed mechanism base, TWO mobile parts frozen in their native armed pose, and its specialized hardware. Keep all visible pieces exactly where the reference places them. Full nominal charges (5) are a state value, not a quantity of loose physical supplies to draw. No action, no target, no wound, no movement, no trigger flash, no sparks, no smoke, no charged glow, no UI badge or quantity marker. This is a static source illustration, not an animation replacement.

MATERIALS: Serious grounded repaired survival equipment. Match the original atlas's aged brown timber, dark oxidised steel, restrained iron-red rust, dull bolts and worn grey/olive hardware. Clearly readable existing edges and joins; no ornamental redesign, futuristic equipment, fantasy motifs or excessive new damage. Soft neutral illumination and crisp detailed silhouette. The original flat-colour specialized hardware should become believable material, not a painted annotation or diagram, but its count, topology and placement must remain unchanged.

OUTPUT: Exactly ONE complete isolated mounted mechanism, centred on TRUE transparent RGBA. Preserve every protruding existing part with at least 12 percent clear transparent margin on all four sides. No floor, terrain, base tile, ambient backdrop, coloured matte, cast shadow outside the object, labels, words, numerals, dimensions, watermark, logos, border, reference sheet or additional object. Keep the holes between parts transparent. Native PNG only.
